observations: Photo 0 shows a bare automotive engine block removed from a vehicle, intake manifold and wiring harness visible, sitting on what looks like a workshop floor or truck bed.
No manufacturer badge, engine code, or VIN plate is visible or legible anywhere on the block or manifold.
The text 'CAMON 40' and camera settings (23mm f/1.8 1/128s ISO50) in the bottom corners are a phone-camera watermark, not a label on the engine itself.
Engine shows typical grime, oil residue and wear consistent with a used (tokumbo) part; no new or sealed components visible.
No oil pan, bottom end, or full side profile shown; only the top/front of the engine is visible.

claims.evidence: No import documents, customs sticker, or shipping photo shown.
No written guarantee, receipt, or shop signage visible in the photo.
No video or audio of the engine running, no compression test or diagnostic readout shown.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/displacement of the engine, which drives most of its value
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine ID plate, stamped engine code, or a shot showing the vehicle/engine bay it was pulled from
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since engine value varies enormously by fitment

risks.risk: Internal condition (compression, bearings, timing components) cannot be seen in a static photo
risks.proof: A video of the engine running/idling, plus a compression test reading
Odometer photo from donor vehicle or import papers showing mileage

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillary parts (sensors, injectors, turbo if applicable) not visible in single angle
risks.proof: Photos from all sides including bottom, plus close-ups of connectors and sensors

risks.risk: Guarantee may not be honored or transferable
risks.proof: Photo of a written/signed guarantee slip or shop stamp with contact details

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine ID plate or stamped engine code to identify make/model
Photo or video showing the engine running (cold start) with audio
Photos from additional angles: bottom/oil pan, rear (gearbox mating face), and full side profile
Photo of any import/customs documentation or mileage reading from the donor vehicle
Photo of the written guarantee/receipt with shop name and date
response.reason: The engine's make, model, and displacement are not visible or legible in the single photo, and this is the key fact that determines its price category; even a worst-case price cannot be set without knowing what engine this is.
